cards.subtitle: Deterministic Tomas Moller & Ben Trumbore (JGT 1997) 3D Cramer scalar-triple-product ray-triangle intersection (P = D x E_2, det = E_1 . P, Q = T x E_1, solving (t, u, v) directly in 3D without precomputed plane equations and locking determinant conditioning J = 1.0000x across all 17 wall-tilt stations s = 1 - cos(theta) in [0, 1]) versus naive fixed-XY 2D projected barycentric solver (det_xy = E_1x E_2y - E_1y E_2x = cos(theta) = 1 - s, which collapses to 0.0000x on vertical walls across 16/17 stations) and 64-step Gauss-Jordan refinement.
